caution_findings.evidence_context: Primary paper core peptide for archalan alpha is GCGFTCSPFSSW, while merged DBAASP sequence DBAASPR_22068 is GCGFTCSPFSTF. Database activity rows remain usable only with this sequence conflict preserved.
Percent inhibition values for Fig. 5a are figure/database-supported approximations; exact primary numeric table values were not locally available.

XML declares 40168_2023_1521_MOESM1_ESM.pdf, but local landed assets contain HTML landing .bin files rather than the true supplement PDF. Main XML/PDF/Fig. 5/methods provided the activity and database evidence needed for the owned-layer repair.
The paper supports phenotypic anti-archaeal inhibition and ecological antagonism context, but no direct molecular target or killing-mechanism assay is claimed.
